checks.name: forensic scan is pure
checks.why: two identical calls must give identical events, or a cache is leaking state

checks.name: chart computation is idempotent
checks.why: ccCompute must not depend on how often it has run

checks.name: profile canonical form is stable
checks.why: the profile hash is exported with every result; it must round-trip

checks.name: every flagged control point is outside its own limit
checks.why: a red point inside the interval is the 22 September defect

checks.name: no rising-curve finding has an answer in its own channel
no stored Cq is read as a crossing at cycle 0
cycle count never exceeds the largest stored Cq by an implausible margin
no stored Cq exceeds the cycles it could have crossed in
checks.why: a "Cq" of 84.6 in a melt-only run is a melting temperature in the Cq field

checks.name: a melt-only run stores no amplification result
checks.why: melt results must not be written into the quantification table

checks.name: a module without crossings raises no missing-Cq finding
checks.why: endpoint genotyping, gene scanning, melt-curve genotyping and Tm calling report calls and temperatures, not crossings; "stored row with no Cq" is their normal state

checks.name: no analysis reports a raw numeric state
checks.why: calcState must be a word, not a code

checks.name: outcome counts conserve the interpreted rows
checks.why: a summary that does not add up is not a summary

checks.name: distinct findings never exceed raw events
every distinct finding accounts for all its events
checks.why: no occurrence may be lost in grouping

checks.name: integrity findings stay out of the review count
exports do not change stored values
checks.why: building a report must never touch the model
